description: This Java source file defines the 'ResourceNotModifiableException' class, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It indicates that a resource could not be modified due to insufficient permissions, and provides mechanisms for building instances, extracting information from JSON, and setting headers.

classes.name: ResourceNotModifiableException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when a resource cannot be modified due to insufficient permissions. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements PolicyException, with static methods for creation from message or JSON, and a builder class.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe nested class providing a fluent builder API for constructing ResourceNotModifiableException instances, initializing default description and message based on provided policy ID, label, and resource path.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Builder instance initialized with the given policy ID, label, and resource path.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a ResourceNotModifiableException from a simple message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ResourceNotModifiableException from a JSON object representing an error, along with headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a copy of this exception with the specified DittoHeaders.
